The platform enforces, per caller, across every hop.
Test it against a case it has to deny.

Review its grants.

div.span:
Resolve groups per request from the caller's own token. Once access is a combination of columns, use a declared grants table.
Refuse on error. Empty is the default.
Test the denial path.

Your ACL becomes a row-level security policy again, evaluated by the engine rather than by your retrieval code.
Not sized for AI Search workloads.

div.span:
1. Test it against a value no row has. It must return nothing.
2. Tell your two zeros apart: no entitlement, or something broke.
3. Assert on the identity that answered, not on whether an answer came.
